info.name: KarbonKita API
info.description:
API Collection for KarbonKita - Aksi kecil, dampak besar

## Authentication
All protected endpoints require Bearer Token: Authorization: Bearer {{auth_token}}

## Base URL
{{base_url}} = http://localhost:8000

## Flow
1. Register / Login -> token auto-saved to auth_token
2. Use protected endpoints
3. Saga: GET /saga/quizzes -> POST /saga/answer (A/B/C/D) -> GET again shows completed

## Security Notes
- Timezone streak: Asia/Jakarta (WIB)
- Quiz: 1 random per hari, retry until correct, XP only (no eco_points). WRONG answer does NOT leak correct_answer/explanation (anti-cheat). Correct answer only visible via GET after verified (is_completed_today=true) or via DB seeder QuizSeeder.php.
- Throttle: POST /saga/answer limited 10 req/min (anti brute-force)
- Vouchers: DB::transaction + lockForUpdate, seeded mitra kopilokal@example.com

item.name: Get Daily Quiz - Success (1 Random Per Day)

exec: pm.test('Has question and options', function(){ var d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.have.property('question'); pm.expect(d.options).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('is_completed_today'); });

var d=pm.response.json().data; if(d && d.id){ pm.collectionVariables.set('quiz_id', d.id); console.log('quiz_id saved: '+d.id); if(d.correct_answer) pm.collectionVariables.set('correct_answer', d.correct_answer); }

request.description: 1 quiz random per hari (WIB). Deterministic per user+date. Returns same quiz until answered correctly. Hide correct_answer unless is_completed_today=true.

item.name: Answer Quiz - Wrong Answer (Retry Allowed)

exec: pm.test('is_correct false and no leak', function(){ var d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.is_correct).to.be.false; pm.expect(d).to.not.have.property('correct_answer'); pm.expect(d).to.not.have.property('explanation'); pm.expect(d.xp_earned).to.eql(0); });
pm.test('Secure: no correct_answer leaked', function(){ var raw=pm.response.text(); pm.expect(raw).to.not.include('correct_answer'); });
// Pick wrong answer - try B, if you suspect B is correct, change to A/C/D manually

request.description: Send wrong answer on purpose. Expect 200 is_correct:false, xp_earned 0, boleh retry. Tip: check correct_answer from DB or try A/B/C/D until correct. If this happens to be correct, status will be 200 is_correct:true instead.

item.description: Kirim jawaban SALAH. Response TIDAK mengandung correct_answer/explanation (anti-cheat, aman dari hacker). Expect 200 is_correct:false, xp_earned 0, boleh retry sampai benar. correct_answer hanya terlihat setelah verified via GET Daily Quiz After Completed (is_completed_today=true) atau lihat seeder QuizSeeder.php.

item.name: Answer Quiz - Success (Correct, XP Only)

exec: if(pm.response.code===409){ pm.test('Already completed 409', function(){ pm.expect(pm.response.json().success).to.be.false; }); console.warn('Already completed today - run Setup Fresh Quiz User'); } else { pm.test('Status 200', function(){ pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test('is_correct true and XP', function(){ var d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.is_correct).to.be.true; pm.expect(d.xp_earned).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(d).to.not.have.property('correct_answer'); }); }
var d=(pm.response.json().data||{}); if(d && d.is_correct){ console.log('Correct! XP:'+d.xp_earned+' streak:'+d.streak_days); }

request.description: Send correct answer (set correct_answer var manually from DB or from previous wrong response's correct_answer field, or from GET after completed). Expect XP only, no eco_points change. If correct_answer var empty, replace with A/B/C/D manually.

item.description: Kirim jawaban BENAR. correct_answer TIDAK bocor dari Wrong Answer (secure), jadi set variable correct_answer manual: lihat QuizSeeder.php mapping atau coba A/B/C/D (max 4 retry). Setelah Wrong, coba ganti correct_answer var sampai is_correct:true. Expect 200 is_correct:true + xp_earned. Jika 409, sudah completed hari ini -> jalankan Setup Fresh Quiz User.

request.description: After correct answer today, any further POST -> 409 You have already completed today. Test after 'Success' request.
